capabilities: Look up a selected word via right-click context menu
Display Wiktionary definitions, etymology and synonyms in a sidebar
Fetch entries from each word's native Wiktionary edition
Toggle which of seven languages are queried in settings
Link directly to each source Wiktionary page
disambiguation: Not a vocabulary or flashcard tool; it only displays Wiktionary entries for words you look up.
extras: Desktop only (Windows, macOS, Linux); requires Obsidian 0.15.0 or later; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Looking up a word's definition requires leaving Obsidian and opening a Wiktionary page manually.

relations.evidence: Each language is fetched from its own native Wiktionary edition via the MediaWiki action=parse API

summary: Dictionary lookup plugin that shows Wiktionary entries for a selected word in a sidebar, pulled from seven native language editions.
